tiles.quote: Alexandria Eschate, 'Alexandria the Furthest', was a city founded by Alexander the Great in 329 BCE on the Syr Darya (Jaxartes) at the entrance to the Fergana Valley, at or near modern Khujand in Tajikistan

note: Antalya was Attalia (Attalus II of Pergamon), Plovdiv was Philippopolis (Philip II)
